opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an established independent researcher based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position with teaching duties. Co‑applicant must be from a different Academy remit (social sciences/humanities, engineering, or natural sciences).
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research for established researchers to collaborate across the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering, with up to £200,000 funding for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK‑based researcher of any career stage who has prior public‑engagement experience; previous award holders cannot reapply.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £8,000 for innovative public‑engagement projects in the humanities and social sciences, delivered in partnership with GLAM or performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Travel, accommodation and visa funding for early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, with a doctorate awarded between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, and not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships (80 % of salary costs funded) to support independent research leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, working in the humanities or social sciences; independent researchers are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 for skill‑development, methodological innovation or interdisciplinary capacity‑building, lasting 6–12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with overseas co‑applicants; projects must be genuinely interdisciplinary and led by the humanities/social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding for 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on ‘Mobilities’, encouraging collaboration across SHAPE and STEM disciplines, up to £300,000 (80 % FEC).

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; placement at DGAP Berlin; no specific disciplinary restriction.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) to develop policy‑relevant analysis and networks in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, hosted at DGAP.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must be based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Rolling‑deadline funding to support additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) for award‑holders or applicants, up to £4,000.
